intraoperativeFindings.findings: Thin-walled gallbladder containing multiple small stones; no adhesions; critical view of safety achieved.
intraoperativeFindings.procedurePerforme: Laparoscopic cholecystectomy with clipping of cystic duct and artery
anaesthesiaSummary.medicationsAdminister: Propofol, fentanyl, rocuronium, sevoflurane, ondansetron, dexamethasone
complicationsAssessment.narrative: No intra-operative or immediate post-operative complications.
postopPlanInstructions.medicationsPrescr: Paracetamol 1 g QDS, ibuprofen 400 mg TDS PRN
postopPlanInstructions.thromboprophylaxi: Early mobilisation; TEDS only (low risk, day case)

postopPlanInstructions.dietPlan: Free fluids then light diet once awake
postopPlanInstructions.woundCareInstruct: Keep dressings dry 48 h; remove at 7 days
postopPlanInstructions.followUpPlan: Telephone review at 2 weeks; histology to GP
